artifact_hash.description: Optional-but-declared: sha256 of the source artifact record/image for this inscription, where the supplier provides one.

inscription_id.description: Source-assigned ID. Must be unique within the dataset (validator rejects duplicates); dedup and provenance key on it.

object_type.description: Optional-but-declared: object type (seal, tablet, ...). Not consumed by spec 018; absence warns.

object_id.description: Optional: catalogue/object ID (e.g. a CISI-style ID) distinct from the source-assigned inscription_id.

source_reference.description: Where this inscription comes from in the source (record/object/file identifier).

sign_list.description: Declared sign list: which numbering/segmentation the tokens use. Adapters (spec 018 section 7) and any Phase-122-style crosswalk are chosen from this declaration; an undeclared sign list is a reject.

sign_list_detail.description: Optional-but-declared: version/segmentation detail of the sign list (required in practice when sign_list is 'other'; absence then warns).

site.description: Site value. The key is REQUIRED (spec 018 section 6.1.5 consumes site values: PRED-2026-003 needs >= 2 distinct non-null sites); null is permitted but warns and makes PRED-2026-003 non-evaluable.

tokens.description: Sign sequence as a token list, in the source's own transcription order (spec 018 assumption A1: adapters never reverse). The section 5 dedup protocol consumes this list. An empty list warns.

description: Phase-130 (spec 021) intake schema. REQUIRED fields are exactly those consumed by spec 018 (Phase-119): the section 4 evaluability matrix and section 6.1 gates (source_class, provenance/license basis, site values, content identity), the section 5 dedup protocol (inscription_id, tokens), and the section 7 adapter inputs (sign_list declaration, per-inscription provenance). All other declared fields are optional-but-declared: a conforming dataset MAY omit them; the validator warns when recommended ones are absent. The enforcing validator is glossa_lab.intake.validate_dataset (stdlib only; this file is the canonical human/machine-readable statement of the same contract, and tests assert the two agree on required fields, enums and version).

acquisition_date.description: Optional-but-declared: ISO date the dataset was acquired; becomes the harness provenance 'date'. Absence warns.

compiler.description: Optional-but-declared: person/organisation that compiled the dataset. Absence warns.

dataset_name.description: Dataset name; becomes the harness provenance 'name'.

license_basis.description: License or acquisition basis, verbatim where known (spec 018 section 7 provenance 'license'). Presence is a hard gate: a dataset with no declared lawful basis is REJECTED, never warned through.

schema_version.description: Intake schema version. Unsupported values are a reject.

source.description: Origin description / file path / URL; harness provenance 'source' (spec 018 sections 6.1.2, 7).

source_class.description: Declared class, one of spec 018 section 4's six frozen source classes. Intake verifies it against upstream_lineage and assigns per-prediction evaluability from it.

text_rule.description: Optional-but-declared at intake (required later in the section 7 provenance log; the responsible adapter supplies it at ingestion if absent here): how sequences were read from the source.

unit_rule.description: Optional-but-declared at intake (see text_rule): what counts as one inscription.

upstream_lineage.description: Upstream lineage declaration: what this dataset derives from. Consumed by the evaluability-class assignment (derivation-adjacency is a lineage fact, spec 018 section 4).

derived_from.description: Immediate upstream source/compilation, or 'original transcription' where applicable.

is_derivation_input.description: True if any content of this dataset (or its upstream) fed a derivation input of the program (e.g. the mayig ICIT feature extract behind the CGSA classes).

upstream_dataset_ids.description: Optional: identifiers of upstream datasets, where known.

title: Glossa Lab incoming inscription dataset (intake schema v1)
